posts.text:
Two cases of Chinese men literally CHASING after kittens that they failed to kill the first time to ensure that they successfully kill them in the space of a week. One by stomping on the kitten repreatedly. One by swinging the kitten by its tail and slamming it so hard on the concrete that it shattered and died 😭 

Both in daylight. Both in public. They don't care about being recorded on CCTV. So much *literal* murderous rage inflicted and committed against felines specifically in China. Why?

@MFA_China @SpoxCHN_MaoNing @SpoxCHN_LinJian @SpokespersonCHN @AmbXieFeng is this #safechina that you're trying to promote? Do you think tourists from Western countries will enjoy seeing these constant legal occurrences of people brutally killing stray cats in public with impunity?
